lede.withToken: Choose a new password. Once saved, all open sessions will be ended.
lede.noToken: Enter your email or phone number, and we'll send you a link to reset your password.

request.doneBody: If such an account exists, we've sent a password reset link to its address. We don't disclose whether an address is registered — otherwise this form could be used to find out other people's addresses.
request.undeliverableWarning: Email delivery isn't set up on this deployment yet, so the message won't arrive. If you can't sign in, please contact support.

confirm.genericError: Couldn't change the password. The link may have expired — request a new one.
confirm.doneBody: All open sessions have been ended — you'll need to sign in again on every device.
